import Mathlib.Data.Real.Basic
import Mathlib.Data.Nat.Basic
import Mathlib.Data.List.Basic
import Mathlib.Algebra.Order.Field.Basic

structure Shape where
  dims : List Nat
  deriving Repr, DecidableEq

def Shape.ndim (s : Shape) : Nat := s.dims.length

def Shape.totalSize (s : Shape) : Nat := s.dims.foldl (· * ·) 1

def Shape.isValid (s : Shape) : Prop := s.dims.length > 0 ∧ s.totalSize > 0

instance : Inhabited Shape where
  default := { dims := [1] }

structure Tensor where
  data : Array Float
  shape : Shape
  deriving Repr

def Tensor.size (t : Tensor) : Nat := t.data.size

def Tensor.ndim (t : Tensor) : Nat := t.shape.ndim

instance : Inhabited Tensor where
  default := { data := #[], shape := { dims := [] } }

structure RSFLayerConfig where
  clip_min : Float := -5.0
  clip_max : Float := 5.0
  seed_offset : Nat := 0
  deriving Repr, DecidableEq

structure RSFLayer where
  s_weight : Tensor
  t_weight : Tensor
  s_bias : Tensor
  t_bias : Tensor
  s_weight_grad : Tensor
  t_weight_grad : Tensor
  s_bias_grad : Tensor
  t_bias_grad : Tensor
  dim : Nat
  clip_min : Float
  clip_max : Float
  initialized : Bool
  deriving Repr

instance : Inhabited RSFLayer where
  default := {
    s_weight := default
    t_weight := default
    s_bias := default
    t_bias := default
    s_weight_grad := default
    t_weight_grad := default
    s_bias_grad := default
    t_bias_grad := default
    dim := 0
    clip_min := -5.0
    clip_max := 5.0
    initialized := false
  }

structure RSF where
  layers : Array RSFLayer
  num_layers : Nat
  dim : Nat
  initialized : Bool
  deriving Repr

instance : Inhabited RSF where
  default := { layers := #[], num_layers := 0, dim := 0, initialized := false }

inductive RSFError where
  | InvalidDimension
  | InvalidLayerCount
  | NotInitialized
  | ShapeMismatch
  | InvalidEpsilon
  | UnsupportedVersion
  deriving Repr, DecidableEq

def RSFLayerConfig.default : RSFLayerConfig :=
  { clip_min := -5.0, clip_max := 5.0, seed_offset := 0 }

def RSFLayerConfig.isValid (config : RSFLayerConfig) : Bool :=
  config.clip_min < config.clip_max

def Shape.isWeightShape (s : Shape) (dim : Nat) : Bool :=
  s.dims == [dim, dim]

def Shape.isBiasShape (s : Shape) (dim : Nat) : Bool :=
  s.dims == [1, dim]

def Tensor.isZeroBool (t : Tensor) : Bool :=
  t.data.all (· == 0.0)

def Tensor.hasShape (t : Tensor) (s : Shape) : Bool :=
  t.shape == s

def Tensor.dataSizeMatchesShape (t : Tensor) : Bool :=
  t.data.size == t.shape.totalSize

def Tensor.isValidBool (t : Tensor) : Bool :=
  t.dataSizeMatchesShape && t.shape.dims.length > 0

def RSFLayer.isValidBool (layer : RSFLayer) : Bool :=
  layer.dim > 0 &&
  layer.clip_min < layer.clip_max &&
  layer.s_weight.shape.isWeightShape layer.dim &&
  layer.t_weight.shape.isWeightShape layer.dim &&
  layer.s_bias.shape.isBiasShape layer.dim &&
  layer.t_bias.shape.isBiasShape layer.dim &&
  layer.s_weight_grad.shape.isWeightShape layer.dim &&
  layer.t_weight_grad.shape.isWeightShape layer.dim &&
  layer.s_bias_grad.shape.isBiasShape layer.dim &&
  layer.t_bias_grad.shape.isBiasShape layer.dim

def RSFLayer.isInitializedBool (layer : RSFLayer) : Bool :=
  layer.initialized && layer.isValidBool

def RSF.isValidBool (rsf : RSF) : Bool :=
  rsf.dim > 0 &&
  rsf.num_layers > 0 &&
  rsf.layers.size == rsf.num_layers &&
  rsf.layers.all (fun layer => layer.isValidBool && layer.dim == rsf.dim)

def RSF.isInitializedBool (rsf : RSF) : Bool :=
  rsf.initialized && rsf.isValidBool

def computeXavierStd (dim : Nat) : Float :=
  if dim == 0 then 0.0
  else
    let fan_in := Float.ofNat dim
    let fan_out := Float.ofNat dim
    let fan_sum := fan_in + fan_out
    if fan_sum > 0 then Float.sqrt (2.0 / fan_sum) else 0.0

def createZeroTensor (shape : Shape) : Tensor :=
  { data := Array.mkArray shape.totalSize 0.0, shape := shape }

def createWeightShape (dim : Nat) : Shape :=
  { dims := [dim, dim] }

def createBiasShape (dim : Nat) : Shape :=
  { dims := [1, dim] }

def pseudoRandom (seed idx : Nat) : Float :=
  let val := (seed + idx * 1103515245 + 12345) % 2147483648
  Float.ofNat val / 2147483648.0

def createRandomTensor (shape : Shape) (low high : Float) (seed : Nat) : Tensor :=
  let size := shape.totalSize
  let range := high - low
  let data := Array.ofFn fun i : Fin size =>
    let normalized := pseudoRandom seed i.val
    low + range * normalized
  { data := data, shape := shape }

def RSFLayer.create (dim : Nat) (config : RSFLayerConfig) : Except RSFError RSFLayer :=
  if dim == 0 then
    Except.error RSFError.InvalidDimension
  else
    let xavier_std := computeXavierStd dim
    let weight_shape := createWeightShape dim
    let bias_shape := createBiasShape dim
    let s_w := createRandomTensor weight_shape (-xavier_std) xavier_std (42 + config.seed_offset)
    let t_w := createRandomTensor weight_shape (-xavier_std) xavier_std (43 + config.seed_offset)
    let s_b := createZeroTensor bias_shape
    let t_b := createZeroTensor bias_shape
    let s_w_grad := createZeroTensor weight_shape
    let t_w_grad := createZeroTensor weight_shape
    let s_b_grad := createZeroTensor bias_shape
    let t_b_grad := createZeroTensor bias_shape
    Except.ok {
      s_weight := s_w
      t_weight := t_w
      s_bias := s_b
      t_bias := t_b
      s_weight_grad := s_w_grad
      t_weight_grad := t_w_grad
      s_bias_grad := s_b_grad
      t_bias_grad := t_b_grad
      dim := dim
      clip_min := config.clip_min
      clip_max := config.clip_max
      initialized := true
    }

def RSFLayer.init (dim : Nat) : Except RSFError RSFLayer :=
  RSFLayer.create dim RSFLayerConfig.default

def RSFLayer.initWithConfig (dim : Nat) (config : RSFLayerConfig) : Except RSFError RSFLayer :=
  RSFLayer.create dim config

def RSFLayer.deinit (layer : RSFLayer) : RSFLayer :=
  if layer.initialized then
    { layer with initialized := false }
  else
    layer

def Tensor.zeroOut (t : Tensor) : Tensor :=
  { t with data := Array.mkArray t.data.size 0.0 }

def RSFLayer.zeroGradients (layer : RSFLayer) : RSFLayer :=
  if layer.initialized then
    { layer with
      s_weight_grad := layer.s_weight_grad.zeroOut
      t_weight_grad := layer.t_weight_grad.zeroOut
      s_bias_grad := layer.s_bias_grad.zeroOut
      t_bias_grad := layer.t_bias_grad.zeroOut
    }
  else
    layer

def Tensor.transpose2D (t : Tensor) : Option Tensor :=
  match t.shape.dims with
  | [rows, cols] =>
    if rows == 0 || cols == 0 then none
    else
      let newShape : Shape := { dims := [cols, rows] }
      let newSize := cols * rows
      let newData := Array.ofFn fun i : Fin newSize =>
        let newRow := i.val / rows
        let newCol := i.val % rows
        let oldIdx := newCol * cols + newRow
        if h : oldIdx < t.data.size then t.data[oldIdx] else 0.0
      some { data := newData, shape := newShape }
  | _ => none

def Tensor.matmul (a b : Tensor) : Option Tensor :=
  match a.shape.dims, b.shape.dims with
  | [m, k1], [k2, n] =>
    if k1 == k2 && k1 > 0 && m > 0 && n > 0 then
      let k := k1
      let resultShape : Shape := { dims := [m, n] }
      let resultSize := m * n
      let resultData := Array.ofFn fun i : Fin resultSize =>
        let row := i.val / n
        let col := i.val % n
        let sum := (List.range k).foldl (fun acc j =>
          let aIdx := row * k + j
          let bIdx := j * n + col
          let aVal := if h : aIdx < a.data.size then a.data[aIdx] else 0.0
          let bVal := if h : bIdx < b.data.size then b.data[bIdx] else 0.0
          acc + aVal * bVal) 0.0
        sum
      some { data := resultData, shape := resultShape }
    else
      none
  | _, _ => none

def Float.clip (x lo hi : Float) : Float :=
  if x < lo then lo else if x > hi then hi else x

def Tensor.clipInPlace (t : Tensor) (lo hi : Float) : Tensor :=
  { t with data := t.data.map (fun x => Float.clip x lo hi) }

def Tensor.expInPlace (t : Tensor) : Tensor :=
  { t with data := t.data.map Float.exp }

def Tensor.mulElementwise (a b : Tensor) : Option Tensor :=
  if a.data.size == b.data.size then
    some { a with data := Array.zipWith a.data b.data (· * ·) }
  else
    none

def Tensor.divElementwise (a b : Tensor) : Option Tensor :=
  if a.data.size == b.data.size then
    some { a with data := Array.zipWith a.data b.data (fun x y => if y == 0.0 then 0.0 else x / y) }
  else
    none

def Tensor.addElementwise (a b : Tensor) : Option Tensor :=
  if a.data.size == b.data.size then
    some { a with data := Array.zipWith a.data b.data (· + ·) }
  else
    none

def Tensor.subElementwise (a b : Tensor) : Option Tensor :=
  if a.data.size == b.data.size then
    some { a with data := Array.zipWith a.data b.data (· - ·) }
  else
    none

def Tensor.addBias (t : Tensor) (bias : Tensor) (batchSize dim : Nat) : Tensor :=
  if dim == 0 || t.data.size == 0 then t
  else
    let newData := Array.ofFn fun i : Fin t.data.size =>
      let d := i.val % dim
      let tVal := t.data[i]
      let biasVal := if h : d < bias.data.size then bias.data[d] else 0.0
      tVal + biasVal
    { t with data := newData }

def RSFLayer.forwardStep (layer : RSFLayer) (x1 x2 : Tensor) : Option (Tensor × Tensor) :=
  if !layer.initialized then none
  else
    match x1.shape.dims, x2.shape.dims with
    | [batchSize, dim1], [batchSize2, dim2] =>
      if dim1 == layer.dim && dim2 == layer.dim && batchSize == batchSize2 && batchSize > 0 && layer.dim > 0 then
        match x2.transpose2D with
        | some x2_t =>
          match layer.s_weight.matmul x2_t with
          | some s_x2_t =>
            match s_x2_t.transpose2D with
            | some s_x2 =>
              let s_x2_biased := s_x2.addBias layer.s_bias batchSize layer.dim
              let s_x2_clipped := s_x2_biased.clipInPlace layer.clip_min layer.clip_max
              let s_x2_exp := s_x2_clipped.expInPlace
              match x1.mulElementwise s_x2_exp with
              | some y1 =>
                match y1.transpose2D with
                | some y1_t =>
                  match layer.t_weight.matmul y1_t with
                  | some t_y1_t =>
                    match t_y1_t.transpose2D with
                    | some t_y1 =>
                      let t_y1_biased := t_y1.addBias layer.t_bias batchSize layer.dim
                      match x2.addElementwise t_y1_biased with
                      | some y2 => some (y1, y2)
                      | none => none
                    | none => none
                  | none => none
                | none => none
              | none => none
            | none => none
          | none => none
        | none => none
      else none
    | _, _ => none

def RSFLayer.inverseStep (layer : RSFLayer) (y1 y2 : Tensor) : Option (Tensor × Tensor) :=
  if !layer.initialized then none
  else
    match y1.shape.dims, y2.shape.dims with
    | [batchSize, dim1], [batchSize2, dim2] =>
      if dim1 == layer.dim && dim2 == layer.dim && batchSize == batchSize2 && batchSize > 0 && layer.dim > 0 then
        match y1.transpose2D with
        | some y1_t =>
          match layer.t_weight.matmul y1_t with
          | some t_y1_t =>
            match t_y1_t.transpose2D with
            | some t_y1 =>
              let t_y1_biased := t_y1.addBias layer.t_bias batchSize layer.dim
              match y2.subElementwise t_y1_biased with
              | some x2 =>
                match x2.transpose2D with
                | some x2_t =>
                  match layer.s_weight.matmul x2_t with
                  | some s_x2_t =>
                    match s_x2_t.transpose2D with
                    | some s_x2 =>
                      let s_x2_biased := s_x2.addBias layer.s_bias batchSize layer.dim
                      let s_x2_clipped := s_x2_biased.clipInPlace layer.clip_min layer.clip_max
                      let s_x2_exp := s_x2_clipped.expInPlace
                      match y1.divElementwise s_x2_exp with
                      | some x1 => some (x1, x2)
                      | none => none
                    | none => none
                  | none => none
                | none => none
              | none => none
            | none => none
          | none => none
        | none => none
      else none
    | _, _ => none

def RSFLayer.getParameters (layer : RSFLayer) : Array Tensor :=
  #[layer.s_weight, layer.t_weight, layer.s_bias, layer.t_bias]

def RSFLayer.getGradients (layer : RSFLayer) : Array Tensor :=
  #[layer.s_weight_grad, layer.t_weight_grad, layer.s_bias_grad, layer.t_bias_grad]

def RSF.create (dim : Nat) (num_layers : Nat) : Except RSFError RSF :=
  if dim == 0 then
    Except.error RSFError.InvalidDimension
  else if num_layers == 0 then
    Except.error RSFError.InvalidLayerCount
  else
    let layers := Array.ofFn fun i : Fin num_layers =>
      let config : RSFLayerConfig := { clip_min := -5.0, clip_max := 5.0, seed_offset := i.val * 100 }
      match RSFLayer.create dim config with
      | Except.ok layer => layer
      | Except.error _ => {
          s_weight := createZeroTensor (createWeightShape dim)
          t_weight := createZeroTensor (createWeightShape dim)
          s_bias := createZeroTensor (createBiasShape dim)
          t_bias := createZeroTensor (createBiasShape dim)
          s_weight_grad := createZeroTensor (createWeightShape dim)
          t_weight_grad := createZeroTensor (createWeightShape dim)
          s_bias_grad := createZeroTensor (createBiasShape dim)
          t_bias_grad := createZeroTensor (createBiasShape dim)
          dim := dim
          clip_min := -5.0
          clip_max := 5.0
          initialized := false
        }
    Except.ok {
      layers := layers
      num_layers := num_layers
      dim := dim
      initialized := true
    }

def RSF.init (dim : Nat) (num_layers : Nat) : Except RSFError RSF :=
  RSF.create dim num_layers

def RSF.deinit (rsf : RSF) : RSF :=
  if rsf.initialized then
    let newLayers := rsf.layers.map RSFLayer.deinit
    { rsf with layers := newLayers, initialized := false }
  else
    rsf

def RSF.zeroAllGradients (rsf : RSF) : RSF :=
  { rsf with layers := rsf.layers.map RSFLayer.zeroGradients }

def Tensor.copy (t : Tensor) : Tensor :=
  { data := t.data, shape := t.shape }

def Tensor.isClose (a b : Tensor) (rtol atol : Float) : Bool :=
  if a.data.size != b.data.size then false
  else
    let pairs := Array.zip a.data b.data
    pairs.all fun (x, y) =>
      let diff := Float.abs (x - y)
      let threshold := atol + rtol * Float.abs y
      diff <= threshold

def RSF.forwardPassAux (layers : Array RSFLayer) (idx : Nat) (x1 x2 : Tensor) : Option (Tensor × Tensor) :=
  if idx >= layers.size then some (x1, x2)
  else
    match layers[idx]? with
    | some layer =>
      match RSFLayer.forwardStep layer x1 x2 with
      | some (nextX1, nextX2) => RSF.forwardPassAux layers (idx + 1) nextX1 nextX2
      | none => none
    | none => none
termination_by layers.size - idx

def RSF.forwardPass (rsf : RSF) (x : Tensor) : Option Tensor :=
  if !rsf.initialized then none
  else
    match x.shape.dims with
    | [batchSize, totalDim] =>
      if totalDim != 2 * rsf.dim || rsf.dim == 0 || batchSize == 0 then none
      else
        let dim := rsf.dim
        let x1Shape : Shape := { dims := [batchSize, dim] }
        let x2Shape : Shape := { dims := [batchSize, dim] }
        let x1Size := batchSize * dim
        let x2Size := batchSize * dim
        let x1Data := Array.ofFn fun i : Fin x1Size =>
          let row := i.val / dim
          let col := i.val % dim
          let srcIdx := row * totalDim + col
          if h : srcIdx < x.data.size then x.data[srcIdx] else 0.0
        let x2Data := Array.ofFn fun i : Fin x2Size =>
          let row := i.val / dim
          let col := i.val % dim
          let srcIdx := row * totalDim + col + dim
          if h : srcIdx < x.data.size then x.data[srcIdx] else 0.0
        let x1 : Tensor := { data := x1Data, shape := x1Shape }
        let x2 : Tensor := { data := x2Data, shape := x2Shape }
        match RSF.forwardPassAux rsf.layers 0 x1 x2 with
        | some (y1, y2) =>
          let ySize := batchSize * totalDim
          let yData := Array.ofFn fun i : Fin ySize =>
            let row := i.val / totalDim
            let col := i.val % totalDim
            if col < dim then
              let idx := row * dim + col
              if h : idx < y1.data.size then y1.data[idx] else 0.0
            else
              let idx := row * dim + (col - dim)
              if h : idx < y2.data.size then y2.data[idx] else 0.0
          some { data := yData, shape := { dims := [batchSize, totalDim] } }
        | none => none
    | _ => none

def RSF.inversePassAux (layers : Array RSFLayer) (idx : Int) (y1 y2 : Tensor) : Option (Tensor × Tensor) :=
  if idx < 0 then some (y1, y2)
  else
    let natIdx := idx.toNat
    match layers[natIdx]? with
    | some layer =>
      match RSFLayer.inverseStep layer y1 y2 with
      | some (prevX1, prevX2) => RSF.inversePassAux layers (idx - 1) prevX1 prevX2
      | none => none
    | none => none
termination_by (idx + 1).toNat

def RSF.inversePass (rsf : RSF) (y : Tensor) : Option Tensor :=
  if !rsf.initialized then none
  else
    match y.shape.dims with
    | [batchSize, totalDim] =>
      if totalDim != 2 * rsf.dim || rsf.dim == 0 || batchSize == 0 || rsf.num_layers == 0 then none
      else
        let dim := rsf.dim
        let y1Shape : Shape := { dims := [batchSize, dim] }
        let y2Shape : Shape := { dims := [batchSize, dim] }
        let y1Size := batchSize * dim
        let y2Size := batchSize * dim
        let y1Data := Array.ofFn fun i : Fin y1Size =>
          let row := i.val / dim
          let col := i.val % dim
          let srcIdx := row * totalDim + col
          if h : srcIdx < y.data.size then y.data[srcIdx] else 0.0
        let y2Data := Array.ofFn fun i : Fin y2Size =>
          let row := i.val / dim
          let col := i.val % dim
          let srcIdx := row * totalDim + col + dim
          if h : srcIdx < y.data.size then y.data[srcIdx] else 0.0
        let y1 : Tensor := { data := y1Data, shape := y1Shape }
        let y2 : Tensor := { data := y2Data, shape := y2Shape }
        let startIdx : Int := (rsf.num_layers : Int) - 1
        match RSF.inversePassAux rsf.layers startIdx y1 y2 with
        | some (x1, x2) =>
          let xSize := batchSize * totalDim
          let xData := Array.ofFn fun i : Fin xSize =>
            let row := i.val / totalDim
            let col := i.val % totalDim
            if col < dim then
              let idx := row * dim + col
              if h : idx < x1.data.size then x1.data[idx] else 0.0
            else
              let idx := row * dim + (col - dim)
              if h : idx < x2.data.size then x2.data[idx] else 0.0
          some { data := xData, shape := { dims := [batchSize, totalDim] } }
        | none => none
    | _ => none

def RSF.invertibleCheck (rsf : RSF) (x : Tensor) (tol : Float) : Option Bool :=
  if !rsf.initialized then none
  else
    match RSF.forwardPass rsf x with
    | some y =>
      match RSF.inversePass rsf y with
      | some x_rec => some (Tensor.isClose x x_rec tol tol)
      | none => none
    | none => none

def Tensor.mean (t : Tensor) : Float :=
  if t.data.size == 0 then 0.0
  else
    let sum := t.data.foldl (· + ·) 0.0
    sum / Float.ofNat t.data.size

def Tensor.variance (t : Tensor) (mean : Float) : Float :=
  if t.data.size == 0 then 0.0
  else
    let sumSq := t.data.foldl (fun acc x => acc + (x - mean) * (x - mean)) 0.0
    sumSq / Float.ofNat t.data.size

def RSF.layerNorm (x : Tensor) (eps : Float) : Option Tensor :=
  if eps <= 0.0 then none
  else
    match x.shape.dims with
    | [batchSize, featureSize] =>
      if featureSize == 0 then some x
      else if batchSize == 0 then some x
      else
        let newData := Array.ofFn fun i : Fin x.data.size =>
          let b := i.val / featureSize
          let rowStart := b * featureSize
          let getVal (d : Nat) : Float :=
            let idx := rowStart + d
            if h : idx < x.data.size then x.data[idx] else 0.0
          let rowSum := (List.range featureSize).foldl (fun acc d => acc + getVal d) 0.0
          let rowMean := rowSum / Float.ofNat featureSize
          let rowVarSum := (List.range featureSize).foldl (fun acc d =>
            let v := getVal d
            let diff := v - rowMean
            acc + diff * diff) 0.0
          let rowVar := rowVarSum / Float.ofNat featureSize
          let rowStd := Float.sqrt (rowVar + eps)
          let origVal := if h : i.val < x.data.size then x.data[i.val] else 0.0
          if rowStd == 0.0 then 0.0 else (origVal - rowMean) / rowStd
        some { x with data := newData }
    | _ => none

theorem RSFLayerConfig_default_clip_order : RSFLayerConfig.default.clip_min < RSFLayerConfig.default.clip_max := by
  native_decide

theorem createWeightShape_dims (dim : Nat) : (createWeightShape dim).dims = [dim, dim] := by
  rfl

theorem createBiasShape_dims (dim : Nat) : (createBiasShape dim).dims = [1, dim] := by
  rfl

theorem createZeroTensor_size (s : Shape) : (createZeroTensor s).data.size = s.totalSize := by
  simp [createZeroTensor, Array.size_mkArray]

theorem createZeroTensor_shape (s : Shape) : (createZeroTensor s).shape = s := by
  rfl

theorem RSFLayer_create_dim_preserved (dim : Nat) (config : RSFLayerConfig) (layer : RSFLayer)
    (h : RSFLayer.create dim config = Except.ok layer) : layer.dim = dim := by
  simp [RSFLayer.create] at h
  split at h
  · contradiction
  · simp_all

    (h : RSFLayer.create dim config = Except.ok layer) : layer.initialized = true := by
  simp [RSFLayer.create] at h
  split at h
  · contradiction
  · simp_all

theorem RSFLayer_create_fails_zero_dim (config : RSFLayerConfig) :
    RSFLayer.create 0 config = Except.error RSFError.InvalidDimension := by
  simp [RSFLayer.create]

theorem RSFLayer_init_fails_zero_dim :
    RSFLayer.init 0 = Except.error RSFError.InvalidDimension := by
  simp [RSFLayer.init, RSFLayer.create]

theorem RSFLayer_deinit_not_initialized (layer : RSFLayer) (h : layer.initialized = true) :
    (RSFLayer.deinit layer).initialized = false := by
  simp [RSFLayer.deinit, h]

theorem RSFLayer_deinit_already_false (layer : RSFLayer) (h : layer.initialized = false) :
    RSFLayer.deinit layer = layer := by
  simp [RSFLayer.deinit, h]

theorem RSFLayer_zeroGradients_preserves_dim (layer : RSFLayer) :
    (RSFLayer.zeroGradients layer).dim = layer.dim := by
  simp [RSFLayer.zeroGradients]
  split <;> rfl

theorem RSFLayer_zeroGradients_preserves_initialized (layer : RSFLayer) :
    (RSFLayer.zeroGradients layer).initialized = layer.initialized := by

        let y2Data := Array.ofFn fun i : Fin y2Size =>

    match x.shape.dims with
    | [batchSize, featureSize] =>
      if featureSize == 0 then some x
      else if batchSize == 0 then some x
      else
        let newData := Array.ofFn fun i : Fin x.data.size =>
          let b := i.val / featureSize
          let rowStart := b * featureSize
          let getVal (d : Nat) : Float :=
            let idx := rowStart + d

            let v := getVal d

## Inicializálás és Létrehozás
RSFLayer.create dim config Xavier inicializálással hoz létre súlyokat (pseudo-random), null bias-okat és gradienseket, Except RSFError-rel hibakezeléssel (pl. dim=0 esetén). RSF.create dim num_layers tömböt készít rétegekből, seed_offset-tel variálva. Tételek bizonyítják, hogy dim és num_layers megmarad, initialized=true lesz siker esetén, és hibák helyesen dobódnak (pl. RSF_create_fails_zero_dim).[2][1]

## Műveletek és Tenor Függvények
Tensor-okhoz matmul (2D mátrixszorzat), transpose2D, elementwise műveletek (mul, div, add, sub), clip, exp, addBias, zeroOut stb. definiálva Option-nel hibakezeléssel. RSFLayer.forwardStep/inverseStep összetett: transpose, matmul, bias hozzáadás, clip-exp, elementwise opok láncolata. Tételek bizonyítják size/shape megmaradást (pl. Tensor_clipInPlace_size), és none-t nem-init esetén.[1]

## Forward és Inverse Pass
RSF.forwardPass/inversePass bemenetet [batch, 2*dim] shape-ből x1/x2-re bont, aux függvénnyel iterál rétegeken előre/vissza. Kimenet újra [batch, 2*dim]-re állít. invertibleCheck forward után inverse-szel ellenőrzi közeliséget (isClose rtol/atollal). Tételek: none ha !initialized, shape preservation implicit.[3]
